QUESTION:
Which other drugs interact with Atorvastatin Calcium?

RESPONSE:
According to the label, Atorvastatin Calcium interacts with several drug classes that require dosage modification: Anti-Viral Medications (including saquinavir plus ritonavir, darunavir plus ritonavir, fosamprenavir, fosamprenavir plus ritonavir, elbasvir plus grazoprevir, letermovir, and nelfinavir), Select Azole Antifungals (such as itraconazole), and Macrolide Antibiotics (such as clarithromycin). When these drugs are used concomitantly with Atorvastatin Calcium, dosage adjustments are required. The label indicates that additional recommendations regarding concomitant use with other anti-viral medications, azole antifungals, or macrolide antibiotics can be found in the full Drug Interactions section (7.1) of the prescribing information.
